acceptance_criteria: BootstrapCredentialDefaults defines AIVIEW_NAME = 'aiview' and initial password 'aiview'
AiViewIdentitySeedingRunner seeds aiview with role:viewer and role:replay_viewer, and idempotently ensures aiview exists even on already-seeded databases

SubnetPreservingIpMasker deterministically maps IPv4 addresses under a durable HMAC key so that addresses in the same prefix/subnet (e.g. cluster VIP and member interface IP) map to the exact same synthetic subnet with identical host offsets, while preserving loopback 127.0.0.1/8 and default route 0.0.0.0/0

TopologyNamePseudonymizer maps cluster names, cluster member hostnames, and virtual system names into synthetic labels (e.g. CLS-ALPHA-01, FW-ALPHA-01-M1, VS-ALPHA-01-APP) while preserving cluster-member-VS relationships

PrivacyMaskingResponseBodyAdvice intercepts outbound responses for GET /devices, GET /devices/{id}, GET /devices/{id}/inventory, GET /clusters/{clusterMemberRef}/inventory, and GET /api/v2/jobs when authenticated session holds role:replay_viewer, returning deep-masked copies without mutating cached or database entities
When authenticated as nexusadmin, responses contain unmasked raw production data unchanged
All tests in :platform-core:test, :persistence:test, and :service:test pass cleanly
Repository privacy check (python3 scripts/repository_privacy_check.py) passes with 0 findings

requirements: In RoleToken.java (ui2/platform-core): add public static final String REPLAY_VIEWER = 'role:replay_viewer';

Create HmacKeyProvider.java in ui2/service/privacy: loads or generates a durable HMAC secret key.

Create SubnetPreservingIpMasker.java in ui2/service/privacy: parses IPv4 addresses (with or without /mask). Preserves subnet containment, host offsets, loopback 127.0.0.1/8 and 0.0.0.0/0. Includes maskText for logs.
Create TopologyNamePseudonymizer.java in ui2/service/privacy: maps cluster names, member names, and virtual system names into synthetic readable names while preserving cross-references.
Create PrivacyMaskingResponseBodyAdvice.java in ui2/service/privacy: annotated with @ControllerAdvice, implementing ResponseBodyAdvice<Object>. Activated on role:replay_viewer.
In GateChainInterceptor.java: attach IS_REPLAY_VIEWER_ATTRIBUTE when actor holds role:replay_viewer.
Write unit tests verifying subnet preservation, pseudonymization, and advice funnel.
Verify tests and privacy gates pass cleanly.
